README.md:
# example.com/acme/shop

Requires Go 1.27.1 and Gonex v0.1.0. Dependencies must be available through your Go module proxy; unpublished development versions require an explicit local workspace/dependency override supplied by the developer.

```sh
go mod tidy
gonex create module users
gonex check
gonex run
```

HTTP defaults to 127.0.0.1:8080. GET /healthz returns {"status":"ok"}; GET /openapi.json exports OpenAPI 3.1. Set HTTP_ADDRESS to override. Ctrl+C stops gracefully. Set GONEX_DISABLE_OPENAPI=1 to disable the public document.

Modules live in modules/, HTTP schemas in http/schemas.go. Business services use plain Go dependencies. Generated registries and .gonex.json belong to Gonex; other files are yours. All generators support --dry-run and refuse overwrites. Persistence is opt-in with --db; configure DATABASE_URL and explicitly run gonex db migrate before serving.
